customer: Well, I've finally decided to part with my big old SUV since I don't do the long road trips to see the grandkids like I used to, and I've been digging through every drawer in the house looking for the title. My late husband always kept the paperwork, and I just can't find a paper title anywhere, so now I'm worried I can't sell it to you at all. I live in Texas, if that makes any difference. Do I need to order a replacement before I come in?
agent: Good news: Texas uses electronic titles, so your title is a record held by the state rather than a paper document, which is why you aren't finding one. When you sell to us, there's no paper title to bring, and we transfer the title electronically at your appointment. If there was ever a loan on the SUV, the lender releases the lien electronically as well, and our article "My loan is paid off but the lien is still on the title" covers that situation if it applies to you.
